benchmark_success.text: For this single-task case, success is the released evaluator returning 1.0; here that means the post-run Android global setting `bluetooth_on` equals `1`.

checked_by.text: A post-run ADB-visible check of `settings get global bluetooth_on`.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Post-run command output or system-settings snapshot containing `global.bluetooth_on` / `settings get global bluetooth_on`.
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained post-run value equal `1`?

success_if.text: Retained post-run evidence shows `settings get global bluetooth_on` decoded to `1`.

fail_if.text: Retained post-run evidence shows `settings get global bluetooth_on` decoded to any value other than `1` (including `0`).

undecided_if.text: No retained post-run evidence reliably shows the queried `bluetooth_on` value.
undecided_if.rationale: Without the evaluator-visible setting value, the benchmark outcome cannot be reconstructed from stored artifacts.
